top_choice_rationale: P001 is a single, precisely cited prize for targeted protein degradation: Crews and Deshaies conceived and demonstrated the designed bifunctional degrader, and Ciulli made it rational through VHL ligands, all-small-molecule degraders and ternary-complex structures with measurable cooperativity, the quantitative link between structure, thermodynamics and function that makes it chemistry. It has been confirmed independently for two decades across ligases and targets. The weaknesses are omitted credit (Handa, Ito, Sakamoto, Kim, Gray) and no approved heterobifunctional degrader, but the principle is mature enough and a citation on the mechanism avoids hinging on clinical results. P002 follows because it keeps the same topic but conflates the cereblon target-identification lineage with the designed-degrader lineage; P003 and P004 pair weaker or narrower parts with base editing or C-N coupling, which I see as an extension of the 2010 prize; any award ranks above no award.
